blocks.text: SecurityScorecard is an information security company that rates cybersecurity postures of companies via scored analysis of cyber threat intelligence signals for third-party management and IT risk management. To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and SecurityScorecard Deployment Guide.
For the SecurityScorecard stream, see Configuring the SecurityScorecard Connector.
To configure the SecurityScorecard Alerts connector, you need the source authentication configuration. To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and SecurityScorecard Deployment Guide.
To create the SecurityScorecard Alerts data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the SecurityScorecard Alerts data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
The Security Scorecard Authentication window appears.
In the Security Scorecard Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.
In the field, enter the username that receives the relevant notifications.

blocks.text: For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
